properties.label: preferred label
properties.comment: A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.

properties.label: alternative label
properties.comment: The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

properties.label: hidden label
properties.comment: The range of skos:hiddenLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

properties.label: has broader
properties.comment: Broader concepts are typically rendered as parents in a concept hierarchy (tree).

properties.label: has narrower
properties.comment: Narrower concepts are typically rendered as children in a concept hierarchy (tree).

properties.label: has member list
properties.comment:
For any resource, every item in the list given as the value of the
      skos:memberList property is also a value of the skos:member property.

properties.label: is in mapping relation with
properties.comment: These concept mapping relations mirror semantic relations, and the data model defined below is similar (with the exception of skos:exactMatch) to the data model defined for semantic relations. A distinct vocabulary is provided for concept mapping relations, to provide a convenient way to differentiate links within a concept scheme from links between concept schemes. However, this pattern of usage is not a formal requirement of the SKOS data model, and relies on informal definitions of best practice.

properties.label: has exact match
properties.comment: skos:exactMatch is disjoint with each of the properties skos:broadMatch and skos:relatedMatch.
